admin.name: Button
admin.what: The one button: teal primary, outlined secondary and the compact tinted pill, with a disabled state. About 102 uses in Admin.
admin.note: Adds focus-visible, hover and loading states.

admin.name: TickButton
admin.what: The office's 'dealt with' control: a teal outline button with a check, used by To-do Clear and notice Resolve.

admin.name: Segmented
admin.what: A row of mutually exclusive options (status filters, List or Calendar, Yes or No). 22 uses in Admin.
admin.note: Gives radio semantics and arrow keys.

admin.name: SlidingSegmentedControl
admin.what: A segmented control whose selected pill slides between options, in teal, surface and ink variants.
admin.note: Keep the sliding indicator with a Motion layoutId.

admin.name: StatusLegend (chips)
admin.what: The List kinds and availability statuses from the status master. With a toggle handler each chip hides or shows that status on the grid.

admin.name: SignalFilterButton (DayGrid focus filters)
admin.what: The Day grid footer's aria-pressed pills (Needs attention, Conflict, Has note, Has warnings) that narrow and regroup the rows, with Reset filters.
admin.note: Not exported: the row mounts the real DayGrid with an empty roster, so only its live footer shows.
admin.sampleData: admin/adminData.ts useSeedIds() todayISO; useAdminDay(today) day.masters, day.warningFlags

admin.name: Dialog (useSurface().Overlay)
admin.what: The web Overlay every Admin sheet opens in: a centred card over a scrim, closed by Escape or a scrim click. About 37 uses.
admin.note: Adds focus trap, initial focus and restore, scroll lock, portal and aria-labelledby; retires the OPEN_DIALOGS stack.

admin.name: MasterPanel / PanelGrid / PanelSection
admin.what: The 600px right side panel the Contract and Party editors open in, with a dialog role, Escape and focus in and back.
admin.note: Adds the missing focus trap and portal.

admin.name: SlotDrawer
admin.what: The 440px session drawer: an empty session's actions, or a List's details, bookings and actions with nested sheets.
admin.note: Adds dialog role, Escape and focus handling. Its actions (assign, edit, reassign, status) write to the demo store, and its List links leave this page.

admin.name: DraftListDrawer
admin.what: The same drawer for a Draft List (no session yet): its details, bookings and Assign, Redate, Edit and Remove.
admin.note: Disabled reasons live only in title tooltips. Its actions write to the demo store.

admin.name: ClearConflictSheet
admin.what: Confirms clearing a hospital-closure conflict on a List, with an optional note.
admin.note: Correct alertdialog role, focus on the safe action. Confirming clears the conflict in the demo store.

admin.name: HistorySheet
admin.what: The audit history of a record in an Overlay, with expandable steps (HistoryTimeline).

admin.name: SideNav (with RolesInfo)
admin.what: The dark Admin side nav: sections with crimson and amber count badges, the wordmark and the Roles in this prototype dialog.
admin.note: Gives real links, aria-current and a nav label; crimson only on --sidebar-primary.

admin.name: Master data sub-nav
admin.what: The vertical list of the 15 master views, with aria-current on the open one.
admin.note: Rebuilt from MasterData's markup and the real MASTERS_NAV: the real nav writes ?view= and renders every master view.

admin.name: TabButton (Integrations)
admin.what: Five underlined tab buttons switching the Integrations monitor between messages, feeds, PDFs, data quality and validators.
admin.note: Not exported: the row mounts the real Integrations screen. Adds tab roles and arrow keys. Some tab actions write to the demo store.
admin.sampleData: live store (the real screen reads its own data as the office)

admin.name: TabLink (AA fees)
admin.what: Route tabs for the AA fee invoices and fee settings pages.
admin.note: Rebuilt on buttons with the same styles: the real one is a router Link that would leave this page.

admin.name: DayNav (with SortToggle)
admin.what: The Day view toolbar: week and day steppers, Today, a native date input bounded by the horizon, the Roster or A to Z SortToggle and Find available.
admin.replaceWith: shadcn Button Group + ToggleGroup + Date Picker
admin.note: Labels the glyph buttons and gives SortToggle pressed semantics.

admin.name: StatusChip
admin.what: A small tinted chip for a List kind or availability status, coloured from the status master.

admin.name: Pill
admin.what: Neutral and success label pills, never teal or crimson, so no pill reads as a button.

admin.name: MasterPills
admin.what: Admin's import path for Pill, used for Party kinds, Contract tags, Active and RVG anatomy headings.
admin.note: A re-export only: delete it in the migration.

admin.name: TierPill / PreferredPill / NotPreferredPill
admin.what: The office-only pairing pills: priority tier, preferred pairing (teal tint) and not preferred (warning outline).

admin.name: ChangedSinceSubmittedPill
admin.what: Flags a submitted List the anaesthetist has changed since submitting, with the count and time of the last change.
admin.note: Driven by a local cue here: the seed has no changed submitted List.

admin.name: DraftListParts
admin.what: Draft List badges: Unassigned, the DRAFT state chip, the waiting time (amber past a day) and the booking count.

admin.name: ConflictDot
admin.what: The amber conflict mark, muted once cleared.

admin.name: WarningTriangle
admin.what: The warning mark on a booking, coloured by the strongest open warning.
admin.note: Its detail is reachable by keyboard once it is a Tooltip.
admin.sampleData: store schedule, billing, appSettings, clock, masters

admin.name: NameSearchBox
admin.what: The one type-ahead name search box, in field and pill sizes; Escape clears it. Each caller filters its own rows.
admin.note: One search input instead of three.

admin.name: ContractSelect (fieldChrome select)
admin.what: A native select of every active Contract grouped by holder, styled with Admin's 48px selectControlStyle.
admin.note: Several Admin selects are unlabelled today; this one has its label.

admin.name: SurgeonPicker
admin.what: A native select of surgeons with a 'Not preferred with Dr X' optgroup for the chosen anaesthetist.
admin.note: The list is long and not searchable today. Opens on an anaesthetist with a not-preferred surgeon, so the second optgroup shows.

admin.name: NotPreferredWarning
admin.what: An amber callout when the chosen surgeon is not preferred with the anaesthetist; it warns, never blocks.
admin.note: Fed by the real useNotPreferredWarning hook for a seeded not-preferred pairing.

admin.name: ChipMultiSelect
admin.what: A native 'Add a...' select plus removable chips, for a Contract's specialties.
admin.note: Searchable, with Backspace to remove.

admin.name: CodePickerSheet
admin.what: The RVG code type-ahead in an Overlay: search by code or description, every match rendered.
admin.note: Gives combobox and listbox roles and arrow and Enter selection.

admin.name: ConflictCallout
admin.what: Warns, before saving, that the hospital is closed that day and the List will be flagged.

admin.name: WarningsToDo
admin.what: The rail's To-do card: every open warning, soonest first, each with Open and Clear, and a show-more toggle.
admin.note: Clear writes a clearance to the demo store.

admin.name: NotificationsCard
admin.what: The rail's shared notification pool: active notices with Resolve, See all and Show resolved.
admin.note: Resolve writes to the demo store. The fresh seed has no notices, so it shows its empty state.

admin.name: VacatedSessionChoice / StatusRadioGroup
admin.what: A radio group of status chips with a roving tab stop: what the vacated session becomes after a move.
admin.note: Already correct; swap for consistency.

admin.name: ProfileChrome
admin.what: The surgeon and anaesthetist record pages' header, id chip, cards, fact rows and History and Edit actions.
admin.note: BackLink is left out: it is a router Link.

admin.name: drawerParts (Section, Row, DrawerLink, ActionBtn)
admin.what: The drawers' section headings, label and value rows, inline links and action buttons.
admin.note: SlotDrawer re-declares its own copies; merge them.

admin.name: Inline success banner (role=status)
admin.what: A teal-tint confirmation line with Dismiss after an action (Conflicts, Draft Lists, Recurring apply, Holiday, AA fees).
admin.note: Inline JSX in each screen, not a component: rebuilt here from the Conflicts screen. Errors stay inline.

admin.name: Table / Header / TextAction / EditCell
admin.what: The master views' table chrome: a page header, a bordered table with head cells, text actions and an Edit cell.
admin.note: Adds sorting with aria-sort, sticky headers and column visibility. Th and Td are duplicated in four files today.

admin.name: ReviewQueue (clickable rows)
admin.what: Submitted Lists to authorise, as a table whose whole row opens the List (tableChrome's isInteractiveRowTarget).
admin.note: Fixes mouse-only row clicks: rows have no tabIndex today. Open is stubbed.

admin.name: RvgGroupsView (grouped rows)
admin.what: RVG groups under anatomy headings (colSpan group rows), with search, an anatomy filter and add, edit and retire.
admin.note: Add, edit and retire write to the demo store.
admin.sampleData: live store (the real screen reads its own data as the office)

admin.name: AuditViewer
admin.what: The global audit feed with a filter bar (two selects, two dates), capped at 500 rows.
admin.note: Virtualisation or pagination replaces the 500-row cap; the date pair becomes a range picker.
admin.sampleData: live store (the real screen reads its own data as the office)

admin.name: TextField
admin.what: A labelled 48px text input with optional mono style and hint line. 59 uses in Admin.
admin.note: Adds aria-invalid and field-bound errors.

admin.name: TextArea
admin.what: A labelled multi-line text input with an optional blur handler.

admin.name: FieldLabel / FormError
admin.what: The field label, and the inline role=alert error line under a form.
admin.note: Ties each error to its field instead of one line per form.

admin.name: ContractPanel (ContractEditSheet)
admin.what: The Contract editor in a MasterPanel: two-column fields, selects, segmented choices, ChipMultiSelect, SurgeonPicker, the RVG code picker and price ranges.
admin.replaceWith: shadcn Sheet + Field + React Hook Form + Zod
admin.note: Save writes the Contract to the demo store.

admin.name: SlotStatusSheet
admin.what: Adds or edits an availability status: name, colour swatches, flags and a live preview, validated as you type.
admin.note: Save adds the status to the demo store.

admin.name: ContractPriceRanges
admin.what: A fixed-price Contract's dated prices as an inline-edit table: Enter saves, Escape cancels, the last row cannot be deleted.
admin.replaceWith: Base UI NumberField + TanStack Table (cell edit)
admin.note: Keep Enter-commits and Escape-cancels. Saving writes to the demo store.

admin.name: MiniCalendar (RightRail)
admin.what: The rail's month calendar with roving focus, arrows, Home and End, Page Up and Down, and today in crimson.
admin.note: Not exported: the row mounts the real RightRail (calendar on top; To-do, notes and Awaiting review below). Keep its key bindings. Notes stay local.

admin.name: HospitalCalendar
admin.what: One hospital's month of closures and Lists: a closure opens it to change or delete, an open day adds one.
admin.note: Not exported: the row mounts the real HospitalsView; choose Calendar. Saving a holiday writes to the demo store.
admin.sampleData: live store (the real screen reads its own data as the office)

admin.name: Native date input (TextField type=date)
admin.what: The browser's own date input, used 15 times in Admin (holidays, redate, audit range, go-to-date).
admin.note: Pass the demo clock's today and the horizon as bounds.

admin.name: SessionTimesFields
admin.what: A session's start and end as native time inputs, with a default or own-times hint and Use default.

admin.name: RVG anatomy datalist
admin.what: RvgGroupSheet's anatomy heading: free text with the known headings suggested by a native datalist.
admin.note: RvgGroupSheet is not exported: rebuilt from its markup and the real ANATOMY_HEADINGS. The real one opens from Add group in the RvgGroupsView row.

admin.name: SuccessOverlay
admin.what: The full-surface success moment: the circle pops and the tick draws, then the flow moves on (Assign Draft List, Reassign).

admin.name: TickBadge
admin.what: The teal tick badge, optionally animated with the complete-tick draw.

admin.name: ProcedureStack

admin.what: One Procedure's procedure text, invoice description, Contract and RVG code on every Booking screen, Admin Review and the List drawer, in full or compact density; still-to-choose parts are neutral and dashed.

admin.name: DayGrid

admin.name: StatusBlock
admin.what: A session block filled by its status: solid, tint, hatched Unavailable or dashed Free.

admin.what: The review page's four summary tiles, then the bookings table with totals and flags, the action bar and the authorise confirm.

admin.note: Tile is not exported: the row mounts the real ReviewScreen. Authorise writes to the demo store.

admin.what: Each billed List's stages (authorised, run, invoices, emailed, Xero) as tinted chips joined by arrows.

admin.what: The invoice as a print-styled document (patient or insurer layout, serif voice) with its info rail. Shown at half size.

admin.what: The ranked anaesthetist picker: a name search, a tier filter and tiered, shuffled-within-tier rows.

web.what: Find cover: every anaesthetist's AM and PM for a day, filters, name search and legend, with Move and Move here gestures.
web.replaceWith: Custom grid (role grid, roving focus) on library primitives
web.note: The real screen; its navigation is intercepted. Move opens the real move sheet, which changes the demo data if confirmed.

web.name: HistoryTimeline
web.what: A record's audit trail in plain English, newest first, under day headings, with coalesced runs that expand. Shown for the seeded Booking with the longest history.
web.replaceWith: Custom, its expandable groups on shadcn Collapsible
web.note: The ledger layout is ours; only the expand and collapse is a library job.

mobile.name: BottomSheet
mobile.what: The mobile modal: a scrim and a panel that slides up from the bottom. It is what useSurface().Overlay renders on the phone, so every shared sheet uses it.
mobile.note: Adds drag-to-dismiss, snap points, Escape, a focus trap with restore, and nested sheets. Must keep --aa-keyboard-inset and portal into the phone frame.

mobile.name: ListOptionsSheet
mobile.what: The action sheet behind the List's ⋯ button: a row per thing she can do with her own List, each with a one-line hint.
mobile.note: Declares role=menu with no arrow keys or focus handling. Either drop the menu roles or use a real Menu.

mobile.name: AlertOfficeSheet
mobile.what: Asks the office to check one of her Lists or Bookings, with a note. Shows a sent state afterwards.
mobile.replaceWith: shadcn Drawer + Field (React Hook Form + Zod)
mobile.note: Drawer adds the focus trap; Field binds the note's error to the textarea. Send writes to the demo store (the seeded record really changes); Demo reset puts it back.

mobile.name: SubmitListSheet
mobile.what: Opened from the greyed submit dock: names each Booking still to finish and what blocks it. Its confirm mode submits the List.
mobile.note: Shown in blockers mode only, so nothing is submitted from here.

mobile.name: AvailabilityEditor
mobile.what: A day's sessions, then the form to change them or add days off. Mobile hosts it in a bottom sheet; web in the right rail.
mobile.replaceWith: shadcn Drawer + Field + ToggleGroup (React Hook Form + Zod)
mobile.note: Same body in a library shell, one form pattern. Saving or removing writes to the demo store (the seeded record really changes); Demo reset puts it back.

mobile.name: Button (MobileButton)
mobile.what: The shared button set: primary (54px teal), secondary (outlined) and pill (tinted, compact). Mobile imports it as MobileButton.
mobile.note: Adds focus-visible, hover, loading and aria-disabled states.

mobile.name: Mobile press feedback (:active)
mobile.what: A CSS rule that makes every enabled button inside the phone UI sink 1px and scale slightly while held. The PWA host adds a touch listener so iOS fires :active.
mobile.note: Moves from one global selector into the Button variants, so non-button tap targets opt in explicitly.

mobile.name: SlidingSegmentedControl
mobile.what: A segmented control whose highlight slides to the chosen cell, measured in layout pixels so it survives the phone frame's scale. Teal, surface and ink variants.
mobile.note: Gives radio semantics and arrow keys (today role=group with aria-pressed). Keep the slide with Motion layoutId.

mobile.name: Segmented
mobile.what: SlidingSegmentedControl with a field label above it, plus a read-only mode that keeps the selection visible.
mobile.note: The label is a div today, so it is not tied to the control.

mobile.name: Filter chips (Week / Month / To-Do / Done)
mobile.what: The pill toggles above the Lists home that bound the forward window or filter to work to do or done.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to ForwardListsScreen.tsx. Already has aria-pressed; the web FilterChip copy does not.

mobile.name: StepperButton
mobile.what: The 44px round-square minus and plus buttons beside each unit count in capture.
mobile.note: Glyph-only today, so a screen reader hears just a minus or plus. Needs labels.

mobile.name: NudgeButton
mobile.what: The small minus 5 and plus 5 buttons that nudge a stamped start or finish time.

mobile.name: CaptureSection
mobile.what: The capture card: a micro-caps label, the body, and an optional footer area pinned to the foot.
mobile.note: The label should become a real heading.

mobile.name: StatusChip
mobile.what: A status pill: coloured dot and label on the status tint, read from the status master so a rename shows at once.
mobile.note: Status colours become --status-* tokens with tint and on-tint values.

mobile.name: ProgressPill
mobile.what: A List's progress as a compact pill: to finish, ready to submit, done, authorised, invoiced.

mobile.name: OutOfHoursPill
mobile.what: The neutral Out-of-hours pill beside a title, with the moon in a header.

mobile.name: AgeChip
mobile.what: An outstanding invoice's age in days (amber past 60 days), with an ACC chip when ACC funded.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to BalancesScreen.tsx.

mobile.name: DayChip
mobile.what: The teal chip naming the picked day; tapping it closes the day view and goes back to the Lists.
mobile.replaceWith: shadcn Badge (as a button, with dismiss icon)
mobile.note: Teal reads as an action here, which is right: it is one.

mobile.name: Avatar
mobile.what: The persona identity avatar: a white chip with crimson initials and a soft shadow.
mobile.note: One of four hand-rolled avatars (the colleague initials on Availability are another).

mobile.name: Hero figure card
mobile.what: The Balances headline: outstanding to you, in large mono figures, with the unpaid invoice count. Static, not animated.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to BalancesScreen.tsx. Reads the persona's real receivables.

mobile.name: EmptyCard
mobile.what: The centred, muted card that says there is nothing to show yet.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to BalancesScreen.tsx.

mobile.name: MovedToYouPanel
mobile.what: The notice at the top of Find cover listing Lists or Bookings a colleague moved to her in the last week, with any message.

mobile.name: Booking card (Capture pill)
mobile.what: A Booking on the List: time, patient, NHI and operation, ending in a Capture pill, a completion tick, or Cancelled.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to ListDetailScreen.tsx. Tap a card to cycle Capture, done, cancelled (local only). Its accessible name is all the text run together today.
mobile.sampleData: mobile/persona.ts useSeedPicks() picks.listId; store schedule.bookings, schedule.procedures, masters.patients; recreation BookingCardCopy

mobile.name: Progress bar
mobile.what: The List's n of m complete line with a green bar that eases to the new width.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to ListDetailScreen.tsx. Gains role=progressbar and aria-valuenow.

mobile.name: LookbackSearchRow
mobile.what: The Lists search field (patient name or NHI, with a clear button) and the calendar button beside it.
mobile.note: One search input instead of three (this, WebSearchField, NameSearchBox).

mobile.name: LookbackResults (ResultRow)
mobile.what: Search results grouped Upcoming and Past, each Booking a card with session, patient, NHI and progress.
mobile.sampleData: useMobilePersona() anaesthetistId; store masters.patients, schedule.bookings, schedule.lists

mobile.name: SeriesList
mobile.what: Her repeating days off, each with a Remove that asks for confirmation inline.
mobile.note: Confirming a removal writes to the demo store (the seeded record really changes); Demo reset puts it back.

mobile.name: ToggleRow (switch)
mobile.what: The hand-drawn switch on the PWA's presenter panel, such as Play the office.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to PwaDemoPanel.tsx.

mobile.name: InstallCoach
mobile.what: The dismissible Add to your home screen tip, with iPhone steps or an Android Install button.
mobile.note: Recreated: src/pwa is PWA-only (its installPrompt module attaches a window listener at import and must not load in the prototype).

mobile.name: UpdatePrompt
mobile.what: The floating snackbar that appears when a new build is waiting: tap to reload into it. Polls the service worker.
mobile.replaceWith: Sonner toast with a Reload action
mobile.note: Recreated: it needs virtual:pwa-register, which only the PWA build provides. Offset the toaster above --aa-dock-height.

mobile.name: BookingDetailBody
mobile.what: The whole Booking capture: patient, ASA, RVG code, times, units, override, billing lines, notes and Mark complete, laid out by the mobile surface.
mobile.replaceWith: React Hook Form + Zod over shadcn Card fields
mobile.note: On a failed complete it focuses the first invalid field by hand; RHF's shouldFocusError does that. The ASA, units and modifier cards (being reworked in catch-up Phase 19b) are live in here. Each tap writes to the demo store (the seeded record really changes); Demo reset puts it back.

mobile.name: TextField
mobile.what: A labelled input with an optional hint tied by aria-describedby.
mobile.note: Adds aria-invalid, a field-bound error and a focus ring.

mobile.name: TextArea
mobile.what: A labelled multi-line field, used for notes and messages in sheets.

mobile.name: FormError
mobile.what: A refused save in plain words, in the error tint, announced as an alert.
mobile.replaceWith: shadcn FieldError (bound to the field by RHF)
mobile.note: Today it sits under the form, not under the field that caused it.

mobile.name: MonthGrid (LookbackDateSheet)
mobile.what: The Go to a date month in a bottom sheet: a dot marks a day with one of her Lists, with a month and year jump panel and full keyboard support.
mobile.note: Keeps the custom day content (dots). Adds grid roles; pass the demo clock's today and the bounds.

mobile.name: My calendar month grid
mobile.what: Her own month: each day is an AM over PM pair of half-blocks in the session's status, with previous and next month buttons.
mobile.replaceWith: shadcn Calendar with a custom day renderer
mobile.note: Recreated: local to MyAvailabilityCalendarScreen.tsx (reads her real sessions). The library gives the grid and keyboard; the half-blocks stay ours.

mobile.name: 6-day date strip
mobile.what: Today and the next five days as buttons at the top of Find cover. A dot marks a day with a free session.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to AvailabilityScreen.tsx. The free dot is colour only and today has no aria-current. The research map files it as Custom + ToggleGroup.

mobile.name: useTickingValue
mobile.what: A hook that rolls a figure to its new value over 320ms with a green flash, and jumps under reduced motion.
mobile.note: Not mounted on Mobile: the mobile surface's BookingTotal renders nothing, so this demo drives the hook directly. Keep the flash tint.

mobile.name: SlideStack
mobile.what: The iOS-style stack: every layer stays mounted, the one behind parallaxes and dims, and an edge swipe from the left pops a layer.
mobile.note: No library ships a stack navigator. The edge swipe is touch only (DevTools device mode). Add focus moves on push and pop.

mobile.name: SuccessOverlay
mobile.what: The full-surface success moment: blurred flood, the circle pops, the tick draws, a haptic fires. The owner hides it after 1050ms.
mobile.note: AA's one standout moment: keep the choreography. iOS ignores navigator.vibrate.

mobile.name: TickBadge
mobile.what: The small completion tick on a success-tint circle; animated it draws and pulses, otherwise it sits still.

mobile.name: Collapsing masthead
mobile.what: The Booking screen's large title folds into a 44px nav row once the column scrolls past 24px, iOS large-title style.
mobile.note: The fold is the real MobileBookingLayout; the masthead handed to it is recreated from BookingDetailScreen.tsx, where it is local.

mobile.name: TimesCard
mobile.what: Start and Finish as one travelling teal action: Start now stamps the demo clock and slides across to become Finish now, revealing the stamp and its nudges.
mobile.replaceWith: shadcn Card + Button, travel on Motion (layout)
mobile.note: Each tap writes to the demo store (the seeded record really changes); Demo reset puts it back.

mobile.name: CompleteBar
mobile.what: The Booking's Mark complete button, which becomes a green success bar with Amend while the List is still open.
mobile.replaceWith: shadcn Button; success state custom on Motion
mobile.note: Local state only here: no Booking is completed.

mobile.name: ProcedureStack
mobile.replaceWith: Custom (a description list on library primitives)
mobile.what: One Procedure's procedure text, invoice description, Contract and RVG code on every Booking screen, Admin Review and the List drawer, in full or compact density; still-to-choose parts are neutral and dashed.

mobile.name: BottomTabBar
mobile.what: The four-tab bar at the foot of the phone: Lists, Availability, Balances, More, frosted, hidden once you drill in.
mobile.replaceWith: Custom nav of links with aria-current
mobile.note: Recreated: local to MobileApp.tsx. Today plain buttons, active by colour only, not a nav.

mobile.name: MobileHeader
mobile.what: The tab-screen header: micro-caps eyebrow, large title and the persona avatar.
mobile.replaceWith: Custom (keep), title as a real h1
mobile.note: The large title is a div, so the screen has no heading.

mobile.name: ListRow
mobile.what: A session row on the Lists home: status rail, session and time, title, and a right-hand cluster (progress, count, chip). Open and closed sessions take the status fill.
mobile.replaceWith: Custom on shadcn Item / Card (status rail stays ours)
mobile.note: First two rows are her real upcoming Lists.
mobile.sampleData: mobile/persona.ts useSeedPicks() picks.ownListIds; store schedule.lists, schedule.bookings, masters

mobile.name: Sticky submit dock
mobile.what: The frosted footer on a List: greyed with what is left, teal Mark list completed, green Submitted to office, or locked once authorised.
mobile.replaceWith: Custom fixed footer with shadcn Button inside
mobile.note: Recreated: local to ListDetailScreen.tsx. Switch the four states with the control.

mobile.name: DockSpacer
mobile.what: An in-flow spacer at the tail of a scroller so the last item clears the frosted dock or tab bar. Trailing padding creates no scroll room on WebKit.
mobile.replaceWith: Custom (keep; part of the inset contract)
mobile.note: Invisible in the app; outlined here so you can see it.

mobile.name: Colleague AM / PM cells
mobile.what: Each colleague's card on Find cover with an AM and a PM cell in that session's status. A free cell her List could move into becomes a button.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to AvailabilityScreen.tsx (today's real sessions). Hatched and dashed fills are domain visuals.

mobile.name: HalfBlock
mobile.what: One session's bar in the month grid: the status fill (or the List's), a repeat glyph for a series and an amber ! for a flag.
mobile.note: Recreated: local to MyAvailabilityCalendarScreen.tsx. Its title never shows on touch.

mobile.name: WarningTriangle
mobile.what: The small marker on a Booking with a warning: a disc in the strongest open warning's colour, with the count when more than one.
mobile.note: The text lives in title only; a Tooltip makes it reachable by keyboard.

mobile.name: OutOfHoursMoon
mobile.what: The moon that stands in the session column where an AM or PM List shows its session.
